description: ZonBarragem - Áreas potenciais para a construção de barragens subterrâneas na região semiárida de Alagoas [CNPS] is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Os vetores (polígono) são resultado do cruzamento de bases cartográficas (atributos) interpretados de solos, geologia (litologia), relevo (declividade e hidrografia) e clima (precipitação pluvial) da região semiárida do Estado de Alagoas com os parâmetros técnicos de construção de barragens subterrâneas (BSs). Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Agreste, CNPS, Convivência com a seca, Semiárido alagoano, Sertão alagoano. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
